native.measurementScope: Native Main/World fixture monitoring, 2.1 seconds warmup/180 sampled rendered frames per case. Engine monitor values are interval-published and repeated reads are not independent per-frame CPU timings. This is not a browser, release build, physical-phone or campaign measurement.
notes: The measured after iteration contains canteen, library-layer and Room204 lazy loading. A subsequent separate one-line lazy load of the hidden c3_opening_view backdrop is covered by functional regression and package closure, not another CPU/GPU timing claim.
Textures and visited canteen nodes remain retained during the current World lifetime for fast reentry. Complete World disposal releases them. This is not unbounded scene pooling.
Observed first canteen construction is later and took longer in this single run. No FPS improvement is claimed: source art, draw calls, rendering scale, physics and gameplay are unchanged.
Initial baseline used insufficient warmup for interval-published engine monitors and is retained as diagnostic only. The steady baselines wait 2.1 seconds before sampling.
The lazy lifecycle test initial draft failed to parse due to a missing explicit int annotation; corrected test passed 27 checks. Raw failure and fixed logs are retained.
